response.sql: SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY tr.ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
